name: Similarity
description: How alike two texts are, from 0 to 1 — for fuzzy matching a typed customer name against the records, spotting a duplicate product, or suggesting 'did you mean'. Case is ignored.

data.assignments: [{"variable":"result","value":"{{= (() => { const x = String(a ?? '').toLowerCase(), y = String(b ?? '').toLowerCase(); if (!x.length && !y.length) return 1; let prev = Array.from({ length: y.length + 1 }, (_, i) => i); for (let i = 1; i <= x.length; i++) { const cur = [i]; for (let j = 1; j <= y.length; j++) cur[j] = Math.min(prev[j] + 1, cur[j - 1] + 1, prev[j - 1] + (x[i - 1] === y[j - 1] ? 0 : 1)); prev = cur; } return 1 - prev[y.length] / Math.max(x.length, y.length); })() }}"}]
